Create a classification nomenclature object

Source: R/00c_nomenclature.R
nomenclature.Rd

Builds a structured handle for a classification, identified by its system (NIS, NUTS, POSTAL, NBB), level (municipality, district, province, region, country, postal) and version (e.g. "2019", "2025", "BEFORE_2019", "2021", "2027"). The triplet must resolve to exactly one known classification.

Usage

nomenclature(system, level = NULL, version = NULL)

Arguments

system

Classification system: "NIS", "NUTS", "POSTAL", "NBB" (case-insensitive). Passing an existing nomenclature returns it unchanged.

level

Granularity within the system (case-insensitive), or NULL.

version

Version string or number, or NULL for unversioned systems.

Value

An object of class nomenclature.

Details

level and/or version may be omitted when the remaining components are unambiguous (e.g. nomenclature("POSTAL"), nomenclature("NUTS", "country")).

This object is the recommended way to work programmatically (loop over versions/levels) and to navigate aggregation links (nomenclature_children, nomenclature_parents). Plain string identifiers (e.g. "NIS_MUNICIPALITY_2019") remain accepted by all functions.

Examples

nomenclature("NIS", "municipality", "2019")
#> <nomenclature: NIS / municipality / 2019>
nomenclature("NUTS", "district", 2021)
#> <nomenclature: NUTS / district / 2021>
nomenclature("POSTAL")
#> <nomenclature: POSTAL / postal>
# Dynamic construction:
lapply(c("2019", "2025"), function(v) nomenclature("NIS", "municipality", v))
#> [[1]]
#> <nomenclature: NIS / municipality / 2019>
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> <nomenclature: NIS / municipality / 2025>
#>
